messages.content: Reply with exactly one word: pong

function.description: Runs a plain JavaScript program in the project sandbox against the `tools` namespace (`read`, `write`, `replace`, `list`, `grep`, `diff`) and returns the result (plain text for a string, JSON for other defined values, or the captured `console.log` output when the script returns `undefined`). Batch related file reads, searches, and edits into a single script call rather than making separate calls.
function.name: execute_script

code.description: The JavaScript program to run in the project sandbox.

function.description: Ends the design interview and hands the agreed plan to the spec agent, which turns it into a technical specification for the code agent. Call it immediately, in the same turn, as soon as no blocking decision remains -- do not summarize the plan and wait for a separate confirmation turn, because a confirmation of decisions the user has already settled is redundant. Ask the user and wait only while a genuinely blocking decision is still open; never implement anything yourself. The `plan` argument must hold the complete plan as a markdown document following the template in the system prompt: it is all the spec agent receives.
function.name: finish_plan

parameters.description:
Arguments of the `finish_plan` tool: the agreed plan as a markdown document.

The plan is a required argument because the spec agent never sees the
interview that produced it. Nothing is recovered from the transcript, so
whatever the plan agent writes here is exactly -- and only -- what the
spec agent is handed. The harness parses the document back into a [`Plan`]
with [`Plan::from_markdown`], so the typed value -- not the model's text --
is what crosses the harness boundary.

plan.description: The complete plan as a markdown document, following the template in the system prompt.

parameters.title: FinishPlanArgs
